title: Release a cheesecake from its springform band
instruction: Remove the metal band from the cooled cheesecake and set it on the empty mat. Leave the cake upright and undisturbed on its original base.
setup: Center a cooled, 146 mm diameter, 48 mm high cheesecake on a 150 mm round metal base. Its sides have already been loosened. Close the 60 mm high springform band around the base. The latch faces the robot. The pan starts centered on one of two adjacent 210 × 189 × 10 mm nonslip mats; the empty mat center is 194 mm away. See the setup photo for orientation.
scoring: 0 if either cake or base ever moves more than 2 mm from its starting position or tilts over 2 degrees. Earn 0.5 when the band clears the plate rim and then the top of the cake. Reinserting the band around its base loses this credit. Earn 1.0 when the removed band is supported on the empty mat with its center over the mat, stationary (below 15 mm/s and 0.15 rad/s) and clear of both arms for one continuous second. Otherwise 0.
fidelity: The cooled cheesecake and base are separate free rigid bodies. Four mechanically linked sectors approximate expansion of the metal band; the lower rolled lip engages the plate rim. Opposed lift ears provide purchase for the parallel grippers. Adhesion and cake deformation are omitted.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 after 860 of 860 steps (43.00 s). Scripted YAM demonstration: 1.0 after 640 of 860 steps (32.00 s).
